articles.title: Iran war live: Riyadh airport hit again; Tehran says US reply ‘inadequate’

events.summary: Iran stated that the US accepted some of its peace terms but termed the response inadequate, amid repeated strikes hitting Riyadh airport.
events.why: Direct negotiations and ongoing missile strikes involving regional infrastructure heavily impact Middle Eastern stability and energy security.

articles.title: Houthi attack on Riyadh airport forces swift rethink of Trump’s new strategy

events.summary: A Houthi missile attack on Riyadh's King Khalid international airport has complicated US administration plans regarding conflicts in Iran and Yemen.
events.why: Targeting major civil aviation hubs escalates regional conflict and challenges international strategic plans.

articles.title: War and high debt to dominate IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok

events.summary: The upcoming IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok will focus heavily on the US-Israel conflict with Iran, high debt, and rising inflation.
events.why: Global financial leaders will address sovereign debt distress and the economic fallout of escalating Middle Eastern conflict.

articles.title: Children among 139 dead after boat capsizes off Djibouti, UN says

events.summary: At least 139 people, including children, died after a boat carrying 305 individuals capsized off Djibouti en route to Yemen.
events.why: A major maritime disaster underscores the severe human mortality along migration routes between the Horn of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula.

articles.title: Homes and bridges swept away as fresh floods hit Nepal
Bridge washed away by torrent of water in Nepal

events.summary: Fresh floods in Nepal swept away homes and bridges. The country is still attempting to recover from floods two months prior that caused thousands of casualties.
events.why: Repeated extreme flooding compounds humanitarian disasters and destroys critical transport infrastructure.

articles.title: Republican senator says Trump diesel agreement with Russia may be illegal

events.summary: A Republican senator criticized President Trump's bid to lower diesel prices by easing Russian sanctions, warning the agreement may be illegal.
events.why: Bipartisan pushback over executive sanctions relief could trigger legal challenges and disrupt global energy trade.

articles.title: Poland stabbings driven by online glorification of violence, Tusk says

events.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk linked recent school stabbing attacks, which killed one and injured others, to online glorification of violence.
events.why: Violent incidents in educational institutions raise urgent national security and regulatory concerns over youth and online content.

articles.title: Saudi health minister visits survivors of deadly Riyadh airport attack

events.summary: Saudi Arabia's health minister Fahad Aljalajel visited survivors of Saturday's deadly attack on Riyadh airport.
events.why: Highlights the human toll and domestic government response to the lethal airport strike.

articles.title: US justice department investigates TV networks over Trump pool coverage

events.summary: The US Department of Justice is investigating television networks over pool coverage decisions after the White House blocked access for several news outlets.
events.why: Investigating press pool arrangements touches on federal oversight and press freedom boundaries.
